title: A re-dispatched attempt is not shown what its predecessors found
description:
Split from tick 35h, which made an attempt's prose report survive teardown (report.md beside the attempt record). That is the precondition. This is the use.

A re-dispatched attempt still starts blind. Its prompt names the tick and the repository; it does not name the reports of the attempts before it, though those now exist on disk. In the ticks pwp run, close-out attempts 11 to 15 each re-derived the same impasse and each surfaced a different subset of findings, because none could see what the last had concluded.

Wanted: when an attempt is dispatched for a tick that has earlier attempts, the prompt lists their archived report paths, newest first, with each one's status line, and says plainly that they are prior analysis to check rather than instructions to follow.

Care needed: a predecessor's report can be wrong, and an attempt that trusts it inherits the error. The prompt should frame them as evidence to verify. Keep the reports local (the executor state directory); do not move worker prose into the target repository.
